item.title: Version 0.9.1
item.description:
Improvements

  • Pro: scenes with dynamic text and scripts use less CPU.
  • The video texture cache stays under its 2 GiB cap during long sessions.
  • Each display shows its panel's native resolution.
  • The Shortcuts page shows shortcuts that macOS refused, and names keys by your keyboard layout.
  • The library import toast lists each item that failed and why.

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: out-of-range sizes, ids, particle counts and script numbers make a scene fail to load instead of crashing the app.
  • Pro: a scene that fails while playing keeps showing its error, and a slow teardown no longer delays the next scene.
  • macOS 26 and later: scenes waiting to load in System Settings › Wallpaper are no longer stopped as stalled.
  • A display cleared on the System Wallpaper page stays empty after a restart.
  • Playlists and schedules recheck their next pick after queue edits and time zone changes.
  • Settings reset and saves that fail to reach the disk now show as failed.
  • Monitor CPU and network readings no longer jump when a counter wraps.

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
